title: Communication Network Span
description: You are analyzing a peer-to-peer communication network structured as a binary tree. The 'span' of the network is defined as the length of the longest path between any two nodes in the tree. This path may or may not pass through the root. Compute the diameter of this tree.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [1, 10^4].
input_format: The root node of a binary tree.
output_format: An integer representing the length of the diameter (number of edges).

examples.explanation: The longest path is 4 -> 2 -> 1 -> 3 or 5 -> 2 -> 1 -> 3, consisting of 3 edges.
The longest path is 1 -> 2, consisting of 1 edge.
A single node has a diameter span of 0.
